title: Brian's Boss items resorcepack
description: Resourcepack of Brian's Boss Items plugin
body:
🛡️ Helmet Details

🟦 Warden Helmet For those who want to stand their ground like the terror of the Deep Dark.

Stats: +5 Max Health, +5 Armor, +4 Armor Toughness, +1 Knockback Resistance, +10 Safe Fall Distance.
Passive [Sonic Boom]: When damaged, releases a powerful Warden sonic boom that knocks back nearby enemies. (Cooldown: 20s)
Recipe: Echo Shards, Sculk Catalyst, Netherite Block, and a Netherite Helmet.
🟪 Dragon Helmet Master the power of the End and rain fire upon your enemies.

Stats: +4 Max Health, +4 Armor, +4 Armor Toughness, +1 Knockback Resistance, +15 Safe Fall Distance.
Passive [Dragon's Domain]: When damaged, summons 6 Dragon Fireballs in a circular pattern to blast away threats. (Cooldown: 30s)
Recipe: Dragon Head, Dragon Breath, End Rods, Chorus Fruits, Netherite Block, and a Netherite Helmet.
⬛ Wither Helmet Channel the destructive power of the Wither to protect yourself.

Stats: +4 Max Health, +5 Armor, +4 Armor Toughness, +1 Knockback Resistance, +10 Safe Fall Distance.
Passive [Skeleton Circle]: When damaged, shoots 10 Wither Skulls in all directions. (Cooldown: 30s)
Recipe: Wither Skeleton Skulls, Wither Roses, Nether Star, Netherite Block, and a Netherite Helmet.
